name: Heroes of Jin Yong
summary: An open-world RPG set in the legendary martial arts universe of Jin Yong. This ambitious project will bring the rich characters, epic battles, and mystical powers of this beloved franchise to life in ways never before possible. Through an exclusive partnership, CreateAI will develop a series of entertainment experiences based on Jin Yong’s works. By combining cutting-edge technology with traditional martial arts storytelling, we’re reimagining these classic tales for the digital age.
